verdicts.criticalReason: Missing required positive automated tests for QA task and direct contradiction of stated Acceptance Criteria: Acceptance Criteria require asserting that the credential transmission service is invoked with the fallback credential and that the user has access to knowledge of the credential. Instead, KnowledgeFirstCredentialTransmissionTest explicitly asserts assertFalse(tokenExists) and fails to verify credential transmission.

concerns.text: The PR diff includes deletions of unrelated test classes (OidcConstructiveProofQaVerificationTest and SeedContentAndOidcConfigurationTest) and minor backend changes in AuthController and PrivacyService outside the frontend UI scope.
